But the register declares the runtime as source_of_truth.terminal_runtime_local_path = _archive/hl_stage2/HL_Live_Copy_Service.py (sha256 e2f04fa8, 5109 lines), and that file has no lease at all: msvcrt 0, fcntl 0, instance.lock 0, acquire_instance_lock 0, CreateMutex 0, lock_file 0, lockfile 0. The shipped/declared runtime has no authoritative lease holder, so the F25 condition is unprotected where the product actually runs.
